name: SaunaLife CL3G | 2-Person Outdoor Cube Sauna
description: Description Experience luxurious wellness at home with the SaunaLife Cube-Series Model CL3G 2-Person Sauna. This stunning outdoor sauna combines sleek Scandinavian design with ultimate comfort and durability. Its full glass front not only offers a bright and airy ambiance but also provides a tranquil view of your surroundings. Crafted with Thermo-Spruce wood and featuring ergonomic Thermo-Aspen seating, this sauna is designed for lasting relaxation and premium performance in all seasons. Features Full-glass bronze-tinted front wall and door for open views and a spacious feel Ergonomic contoured seating and arched backrests for superior comfort Organically thermally enhanced Thermo-Spruce exterior for strength and longevity Thermo-Aspen sauna benches and backrests that stay cool to the touch Shingled roof with drip rails for optimal weather protection Wi-Fi app-controlled white “dotless” LED lighting for elegant ambiance Designed in Scandinavia and handcrafted in Northern Europe Accommodates up to 2 users comfortably What's Included? Cube-Series Model CL3G sauna unit Tempered bronze glass front and door Thermo-Spruce walls and roof with fascia boards Ergonomic Thermo-Aspen bench and backrest LED Light Bar System with Wi-Fi App Control Wireless remote with cradle 90W power supply, driver, and 30’ light cable Mounting clips (articulating and flush) Foundation beams Montage kit and installation instructions Optional Add-Ons Sauna heater (various models available separately) Sauna accessories kit (bucket, ladle, thermometer) Specifications Exterior Dimensions: 53.2” W x 51.2” D x 81.9” H Interior Dimensions: 49.6” W x 43.2” D x 75.4” H Bench Depth: Top 20.5" / Lower 8" / Side 11.8" Door Size: 23.2” W x 66.5” H Glass: 8mm Tempered Bronze Wall Thickness: 42mm (walls), 28mm (front/back walls) Stave Thickness: 1.7” Shipping Dimensions: 70.9” W x 43.3” D x 32.3” H Shipping Weight: 990 lbs Documents Installation Manual SaunaLife CL3G
